metadata.description: Existing, running Windows VM in the deployment resource group.
Single drive letter D-Z, without a colon. Validated in the guest before changes.
Volume label, without quotes or NTFS-invalid characters. Maximum 32 characters.

Relative folders or full paths on driveLetter (for example D:\tempdb\data). Guest validation rejects mismatched drives and unsafe paths, then writes leading-backslash, parent-first native entries. An empty array creates no folders (unverified on Azure).
Exact NVMe temp disk model names. Never specify a persistent/data disk model.
NTFS allocation unit size in bytes.
Stripe size in bytes. Multi-disk behavior remains unverified.
Changes the run-command parameters on redeployment. Supply a new value when retrying.
